variants.name: Premium Hypercarry
variants.why: Furina HP-drain fuels Fanfare DMG buff and self-heals his Marechaussee stacks; Kazuha swirls Hydro for VV RES shred + DMG bonus; Zhongli shield + universal RES shred gives interruption immunity for an uninterrupted beam.
variants.replace: Xilonen for Kazuha (Geo DEF shred + heal vs VV grouping), Baizhu for Zhongli (heal + IR vs shield)

variants.name: F2P Electro-Charged
variants.why: Xingqiu off-field Hydro + Sucrose swirl VV Hydro shred enable constant Electro-Charged; Diona shield prevents interruption. All 4-star except Neuvillette, ~35-45% weaker than premium.
variants.replace: Layla for Diona (better shield, no heal), Fischl for Xingqiu (Electro app), Barbara for Diona (free heal)

variants.name: Premium Aggravate
variants.why: Nahida keeps enemies under Quicken and shares EM; Fischl A4 adds off-field Electro on every reaction; Kazuha VV Electro shred + grouping amplifies her rapid gunshot Aggravates.
variants.replace: Zhongli for Kazuha (shield + RES shred vs grouping), Sucrose for Kazuha (budget VV), Beidou for Fischl (AoE)

variants.name: Premium Quickbloom
variants.why: Nahida Dendro + Furina off-field Hydro spawn Bloom cores; Clorinde triggers Aggravate + Hyperbloom; Baizhu heals to stack Fanfare and gives interruption resistance.
variants.replace: Yelan/Xingqiu for Furina (more Hydro dmg, needs other healer), Zhongli for Baizhu (shield vs heal), Jean for Baizhu (heal + VV)

variants.name: F2P Aggravate
variants.why: Dendro Traveler (free) applies Quicken; Fischl off-field Electro; Sucrose VV Electro shred + EM share. Accessible, slightly less uptime than Nahida.
variants.replace: Collei for Dendro Traveler (better app), Kazuha for Sucrose (premium shred), Yaoyao/Kirara for Sucrose (shield/heal)

variants.name: Overload (Chevreuse)
variants.why: Chevreuse buffs Pyro+Electro in a 2-element core; Fischl + Xiangling off-field enable Overload with no reaction conflict, strong and 4-star friendly.
variants.replace: Thoma for Xiangling (shield), Beidou for Fischl (AoE), Bennett for Chevreuse (ATK, drops OV buff)

variants.name: Premium Melt
variants.why: Citlali Cryo shield + Melt/Frozen RES shred sets up Melt; Xilonen Cinder City RES shred + heal; Bennett massive ATK buff. Highest front-loaded Pyro burst.
variants.replace: Kazuha for Xilonen (grouping + VV vs DEF shred), Sucrose for Xilonen (budget shred), Zhongli for Citlali (shield, drops Cryo)

variants.name: Premium Vaporize
variants.why: Double Hydro (Yelan+Furina) gives strong off-field application + Furina Fanfare; Xilonen RES shred + heal; lenient aura management for consistent Vape.
variants.replace: Bennett for Xilonen (ATK buff vs shred), Xiangling for Yelan (budget Hydro? no Pyro), Zhongli for Xilonen (shield)

variants.name: F2P Vaporize
variants.why: Xingqiu off-field Hydro for Vaporize; Bennett ATK buff + heal (Arlecchino can't self-heal, but Burst reset covers it); Sucrose VV Hydro shred. Fully 4-star except Arlecchino.
variants.replace: Yelan for Xingqiu (premium Hydro), Kazuha for Sucrose (grouping), Xiangling for Xingqiu (Mono-Pyro, no Vape)

variants.name: F2P Overload
variants.why: Chevreuse 2-element Pyro/Electro buff; Fischl off-field Electro; Bennett ATK. All-core 4-star, strong vs groups, also a 7.0 Stygian matchup.
variants.replace: Thoma for Bennett (shield, drops buff), Xiangling for Fischl (Pyro OV), Rosaria/Diona for Cryo Melt variant

variants.name: Aggravate Premium
variants.why: Nahida Quicken + EM share; Fischl A4 adds off-field Electro Aggravate procs; Kazuha VV Electro shred + grouping. Her definitive best team in 2026.
variants.replace: Sucrose for Kazuha (budget VV), Yae Miko for Fischl (more Electro), Baizhu for Kazuha (shield + heal)

variants.name: Aggravate Comfort
variants.why: Same Aggravate core but Baizhu replaces Anemo: gives shield + heal + extra Dendro, trading some damage for interruption immunity and sustain.
variants.replace: Yaoyao for Baizhu (free heal), Zhongli for Baizhu (shield + RES shred), Kirara for Baizhu (shield)

variants.name: F2P Aggravate
variants.why: Dendro Traveler (free) applies Quicken; Fischl off-field Electro; Sucrose VV Electro shred + EM share. Fully F2P, slightly spotty Dendro uptime.
variants.replace: Collei for Dendro Traveler (better app), Kazuha for Sucrose (premium), Beidou for Fischl (AoE)

variants.name: Premium Crystallize
variants.why: Furina off-field Hydro fuels Crystallize + Fanfare DMG buff; Zhongli shield + Tenacity ATK buff + RES shred; Bennett ATK buff + heal. Safe, high ceiling.
variants.replace: Xilonen for Zhongli (heal + Cinder City shred vs shield), Chiori for Zhongli (off-field Geo, C1 best), Layla for Zhongli (budget shield)

variants.name: Premium Geo Core
variants.why: Xilonen heal + RES shred + Cinder City; Chiori off-field Geo DMG + more Crystallize shards (C1 ideal); Furina Fanfare. Top-rated 2026 comp (needs C1/C2 investment).
variants.replace: Zhongli for Chiori (shield vs Geo dmg), Bennett for Furina (ATK, drops buff), Albedo for Chiori (comfort Geo)

variants.name: Double Pyro & Geo
variants.why: Pyro + Geo resonance; Xiangling off-field Pyro for Crystallize; Albedo off-field Geo shards; Bennett ATK + heal. Restrictive but big personal damage.
variants.replace: Zhongli for Albedo (shield + RES shred), Ningguang for Albedo (free Geo), Chiori for Albedo (C1 better)

variants.name: F2P Crystallize
variants.why: Xiangling + Bennett (free, staple) off-field Pyro for Crystallize; Ningguang free off-field Geo shards. All 4-star except Navia, clears Abyss comfortably.
variants.replace: Geo Traveler for Ningguang (free Geo), Fischl for Xiangling (Electro Crystallize), Kachina for Ningguang (Scroll holder)

variants.name: Premium Superconduct
variants.why: Raiden provides Superconduct + ER battery; Rosaria gives CRIT/phys RES shred (C6), Bennett ATK buff. Best single-target Burst nuke.
variants.replace: Zhongli for Bennett (shield + Tenacity ATK buff), Mika for Rosaria (phys DMG + atk SPD)

variants.name: Premium Physical
variants.why: Mika's atk SPD + phys DMG buff maximizes Lightfall Sword stacks; Rosaria shred + Bennett ATK. Highest personal damage ceiling.
variants.replace: Raiden for Mika (battery), Zhongli for Bennett (shield)

variants.name: F2P Option
variants.why: Fischl off-field Electro enables Superconduct; Diona shield/heal + Cryo Resonance, Kaeya battery. Fully free-to-play friendly.
variants.replace: Rosaria for Kaeya (battery+CRIT), Mika for Diona (heal+atk SPD), Beidou for Fischl

variants.name: Premium Melt Plunge
variants.why: Xianyun enables plunge spam; Melt 2.0x on Pyro plunge with Citlali Cryo; Bennett ATK+heal. Highest ceiling (300k+ plunges).
variants.replace: Ganyu/Rosaria for Citlali (Cryo Melt), Furina for Bennett (Vaporize plunge variant)

variants.name: Premium Vaporize Plunge
variants.why: Furina's Fanfare DMG% amp + Xianyun plunge buffs; Vaporize 1.5x. Strong AoE and comfort.
variants.replace: Citlali for Furina (Melt variant), Yelan for Furina (sub-DPS)

variants.name: Classic Vaporize F2P
variants.why: Xingqiu rain Vaporizes every swing; Kazuha VV Pyro shred + group; Bennett ATK. Reliable since launch.
variants.replace: Yelan for Xingqiu (more DMG), Zhongli/Sucrose for Kazuha (shield/VV), Xiangling for Diluc-flex Mono Pyro

variants.name: F2P Melt
variants.why: Kaeya Cryo triggers Melt; Sucrose EM-share/group; Noelle shield+heal. Functional budget team.
variants.replace: Rosaria for Kaeya, Diona for Noelle, Traveler(Geo) for Sucrose

variants.name: Aggravate
variants.why: Nahida EM drives Aggravate; Yae + Fischl off-field Electro; Zhongli shield + Archaic Petra DMG amp. Self-sustaining Quicken loop.
variants.replace: Baizhu for Zhongli (heal+interrupt resist), Kazuha for Zhongli (VV Electro shred), Raiden for Fischl (battery)

variants.name: Hyperbloom
variants.why: Yae's totems trigger Hyperbloom on Kokomi/Yelan Bloom cores; Nahida Dendro+EM share. Homing seeds, strong multi-target.
variants.replace: Xingqiu for Yelan (more Hydro cores), Baizhu for Kokomi (heal), Furina for Yelan (DMG amp)

variants.name: Electro-Charged (Taser)
variants.why: Persistent Electro-Charged storm; Kazuha groups + VV shred; Yelan/Xingqiu Hydro. High AoE uptime.
variants.replace: Raiden for Fischl (battery), Xingqiu for Yelan, Sucrose for Kazuha

variants.name: Spread Aggravate (Premium)
variants.why: Nahida sustains Dendro + EM; Fischl off-field Electro for Spread; Zhongli shield + 20% RES shred. Core Quicken comp.
variants.replace: Yae Miko for Fischl (AoE Electro), Kazuha for Zhongli (VV Electro shred), Baizhu/Kirara for Zhongli (heal/shield)

variants.name: Aggravate w/ Yae
variants.why: Yae's totem interval syncs with Tighnari's charged-shot rhythm; Nahida EM, Zhongli safety. High team damage ceiling.
variants.replace: Fischl for Yae (faster setup), Kazuha for Zhongli, Kuki for Zhongli (heal+EM)

variants.name: F2P Spread
variants.why: Double Dendro Resonance EM; Fischl Spread Electro; Kirara shield. Free-to-play friendly, clears Abyss.
variants.replace: Dendro Traveler for Collei, Lisa for Fischl, Yaoyao for Kirara

variants.name: Hyperbloom
variants.why: Quicken for Spread + Kuki Electro detonates Dendro cores into Hyperbloom. Flexible AoE.
variants.replace: Yelan for Xingqiu, Baizhu for Kuki, Kokomi for Xingqiu
